$comment: Journey tailoring. Edited by a human only; no agent tool can write the journey/ folder. A waiver removes a stage from the path and must carry a reason, an approver and a date. Never use a waiver to backfill a missed gate: record the gap instead. Optional epicScope (for example ["38", "39"]) limits stages 6 and 8 to those epics for this phase; leave it out to include every epic in docs/user-stories.
